metric_definition: SYSTEM_ONLY = T3 + (T8|T9 - T6); excludes Continue CTA dwell (T3→T6) and fare Accept dwell (T3D→T3E)
PROVEN_EXPANDING_SUBINTERVAL: T3→T6 (warm revalidation complete → Continue CTA click → T6 nav)
PROVEN_MECHANISM: R6F/R6G usable T0→T9 and T3→T6 included harness Continue polling (800–1000ms sleeps up to ~45s). Warm T3 marks early; Continue click dwell is not product latency. Post-nav T6→T9 p95≈1.4s; SYSTEM_ONLY usable p95≈2.8s; 0 system outliers >15s.
